title: kate-core: load and save EditorConfig TOML
summary: EditorConfig can be read from a TOML file and written back. The parser accepts only the keys in this packet. Workspace::new does not read the file. The window does not read the file. No new crate dependency is added. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The parser is pure Rust in kate-core. It does not need a window, a Mac, or the owner's eyes. Linux CI is the test run. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

definitions.definition:
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ConfigError {
    Io { message: String },
    BadVersion { found: String },
    BadValue { key: String },
    UnknownKey { key: String },
}

pub fn user_config_path(home: &std::path::Path) -> std::path::PathBuf

pub fn editor_config_from_toml(text: &str) -> Result<crate::EditorConfig, ConfigError>

pub fn editor_config_to_toml(config: &crate::EditorConfig) -> String

pub fn load_editor_config(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<crate::EditorConfig, ConfigError>

pub fn save_editor_config(path: &std::path::Path, config: &crate::EditorConfig) -> Result<(), ConfigError>

| key | meaning |
|---|---|
| format_version | integer 1, required |
| fallback_encoding | encoding_rs label, default windows-1252 |
| document.tab_width | integer 1 to 200 |
| document.indent_width | integer 1 to 200 |
| document.indent_with_spaces | true or false |
| document.remove_trailing_spaces | never, modified, or all |
| document.ensure_trailing_newline | true or false |

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: lib.rs adds mod config and re-exports the error and the five functions. The parser accepts blank lines and a line whose trim starts with #. It accepts spaces around =. It rejects an unknown key, a duplicate key, a second section name, inline comments, and single quotes. A missing document key keeps DocumentConfig::default for that field. save writes the canonical text to a sibling temp file and renames it. A missing load path returns Io. user_config_path joins home, Library, Application Support, KateM5Rust, and config.toml. Do not read HOME in the tests. Do not add a dependency. A new Rust file starts with the LGPL-2.1-or-later SPDX header.

regression_tests.name: config::tests::toml_roundtrip_keeps_the_default
regression_tests.asserts: to_toml of the default config parses back to the same EditorConfig. A second to_toml matches the first string. The string starts with format_version = 1.

regression_tests.name: config::tests::unknown_key_and_bad_version_fail
regression_tests.asserts: An unknown key returns UnknownKey. format_version 2 returns BadVersion. A missing file returns Io. A width of 0 returns BadValue.

regression_tests.name: config::tests::user_config_path_uses_the_given_home
regression_tests.asserts: The path ends with Library/Application Support/KateM5Rust/config.toml under the given home. The test does not read the process home.
